delivery.title: Makani aakutola - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: "Kwiinda" aawa chaamba buyo kuti seva yakapilusya chiimo cha HTTP 2xx - tachisinizyi kuti nzila yakutambula yakabamba naa kubamba lugwalo. Langa bwiinguzi buli atala aawa kuti ubone ncho chakaamba; kuti kakuli buyo naa nkuzumina, eeyo nzila ilakonzya kutambula kulomba pesi yakakaka naa kutabikkila maanu kumulimo mukati (mazina/nzila iitaluzi ya API yayo, busena buyandika kulubazu lwayo oobo bbazu eeli ndyotabikkilizyi, azimwi).

push.title: Webhooks aazwa anze - Kusungilizya akutola zintu zipya
push.intro: Zyoonse zilakonzya kuchinchululwa a webhook : JSON , Foomu (x-www-form-urlencoded), naakuti chikozyano chako cha Custom body a <fieldkey></fieldkey> placeholders (nkokuti <example></example> ) - chibeleka mbuli kuzuzya mulawu cURL chiindi chomwe.
push.curlLabel: Namatizya cURL ya CRM ya kasitoma wako
push.curlHelp: Namatizya zikozyanyo zyakulomba zyamapepa aabo aa API naakuti Postman nzyakupa (a data nchobeni naakuti zikozyanyo). URL , nzila amutwe wamakani zilakopololwa mbuli mbozibede, mpawo kiyi yoonse ililembedwe munsi kuchitila kuti usale CRM iizuzya kuli umwi awumwi.
push.curlPrompt: Sena kuli cURL ya kasitoma? <action>Bweza kuzwa ku cURL</action> kuti uzuzye eechi mpawo ulembe masena aalikke.
push.urlVariables: I URL ilakonzya kuba azintu zikonzya kuchincha, mbuli <urlexample></urlexample> .
push.headersInvalid: Mitwe yeelede kuba JSON iili kabotu, mbuli {{example}}
push.authTitle: Kusinizya (mbuli Leadrat mbwanjila mu API yabo)
push.modeSame: Tuma zyoonse zyakachitika ku URL yomwe
push.modeCreateUpdate: Panga rekhodi lyomwe, mpawo ubambulule rekhodi njiyonya eeyo (kunyina zikozyenye kulubazu lwabo)
push.responseIdHint: Aawo ID mpoili mu JSON yabo kwiingula kukulomba kupanga. Yakabambwa kuli umwi awumwi mbuli <externalid></externalid> .
push.retriesHint: Kuchiindi chakumanizya, HTTP 429 antoomwe a 5xx kulubizya - musule lya 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h.
push.updateBody: Kubambulula mubili (kutakwe chintu = mbubwenya mbuli kulenga)
push.howFilled: Mbuti mpindu mbozizuzyigwa: eeyi webhook ilabelesyegwa alimwi kuli umwi awumwi uusololela - Leadrat taatumi zikozyanyo zitacinci pe, utumina kusungwaazya kupya chiindi choonse chintu chisalidwe nichichitika, azyeelelo zyamuntu oyo.
push.howFilledStandard: JSON / Foomu ilabikkilizya zyoonse zili aamutwe - kunyina chakubamba.
push.howFilledCustom: Chiyanza - lemba mubili wako wakulomba mpawo ubike kufumbwa nkobede; chimwi achimwi chichinchilwa aamuulo wini wamuntu ooyo katanatuminwa. Kotyola chintu chili munsi kuti uchibike.
push.rawTemplate: Chitondeezyo chamubili (chipya) - kuchincha biyo naakuti kubikka zintu zichincha
push.previewEmpty: (lemba chikozyano chamubili atala kuti ubone chikozyano)
push.deleteConfirm: Kuzima webhook " {{name}} "? Eezi tazikonzyi kujokolosyegwa pe.
push.resyncTruncated_one: Resync yakasunka {{total}} yakusaanguna ya {{count}} (mugaano {{limit}} akuzuzaana). Selesya mazuba kuti usunke aambi.
push.resyncTruncated_other: Resync yakasunka {{total}} yakusaanguna ya {{count}} zyakusololela (kugolela {{limit}} akuzuzaana). Selesya mazuba kuti usunke aambi.
push.syncHelp: Sunka zyoonse zilembedwe muchiindi eechi alimwi (siya zyoonse zyobile kazitakwe chintu kuti usunke zyoonse).

receive.title: Amutambule - Amutambule Basikusololela Muchiimo chilichose
receive.intro: Nkozyanisya imwi aimwi ilaa URL yayo. Kotondezya zyaambilizyo zya Facebook , Zapier , foomu yawebbusayiti naakuti webhook imwi ya CRM kuli ncico - balatuma bantu bayanda kunjila mu JSON yabo beni naakuti foomu, mpawo webo ulabamba myuunda yabo kuli yako.
receive.urlIntro: URL yako yakutambula - kopa eyi kunzila yakutumina ( POST , JSON naa foomu-encoded):
receive.newUrlConfirm: Panga URL mpya? Iyakaindi ilaleka kubeleka ndilyona.
receive.sendExample: Tuma chikozyano chomwe kusaanguna - chijatwa mbuli chikozyano (kunyina chintu chiletwa kusikila chikozyano chili ansi aawa chikwabililwe).
receive.securityAuthTitle: Kotambula buyo zikumbizyo zyakasainwa aamaseseke aaya
receive.sampleLabel: Chikozyano chakubbadela (namatika chimwi, naa kusiya kakunyina chintu kuti ubelesye kulomba kwamamanino nkowakatambula)

pull.title: Kokwela - Kubweza Basikusololela kuzwa kuli API iili yoonse
pull.intro: Leadrat yiita API yanzila imwi muchiindi (kuzumizya kuli koonse, kufumbwa kupeeji) mpawo ilaleta zilembedwe nzyapilusya. Malembe ngaakabona katanabambulula nzila njiyonya.
pull.variables: Zintu: <since></since> (kuzwidilila kwamamanino, chiindi cha ISO; kubula chintu chiindi chakusanguna), <others></others>
pull.sampleHelp: Bamba, mpawo ubweze zikozyanyo - Leadrat wiita API chiindi chomwe (peeji lyakusaanguna luzutu) mpo taakwe nchitunjizya.

inbound.title: Malembe aakatambula
inbound.help: Irekhodi lyoonse lyakanjila anzyakachitika kuli ndilyo.

api.title: API yako - nzila zyobile zyakunjila kulizyoonse nzila
api.intro: Kufumbwa nzila iijisi kkii yako API ilakonzya kupanga, kubala akucinca zyintu zikonzya kuchitwa mpawo akulembesya kuzintu zikonzya kuchitika. Tuma kkii mumutwe wa <hdr></hdr> , mbuli <bearer></bearer> , naa (ikuti chibelesyo kachitakonzyi kubikka mitwe) mbuli <query></query> . Mugaano: {{limit}} zyakulomba muminiti yomwe.
api.noPermission: Alikke muntu uujisi nguzu zyakweendelezya zyeelelo nguukonzya kubona kkii ya API .
api.shownOnce: Kopa kkii eeyi lino mpawo uyibike kubusena butakwe ntenda - nkaambo kakukwabililwa ilatondezyegwa biyo chiindi chomwe. Kuti yasweeka, panga mpya.
api.regenerateConfirm: Kupanga kkii mpya API ? Ikkii iiliwo lino ilaleka kubeleka mpawo-mpawo kuli zyoonse zibelesya.
api.openApiHint: Bikka OpenAPI spec mu Postman , Zapier , Make naa n8n kuti zyoonse zibelesyegwe.
